mapper.select: SELECT nc.comment_id, nc.note_id, nc.content, nc.parent_id, nc.create_time, su.nickname AS author, su.avatar, (nc.user_id = #{userId}) AS is_owner FROM note_comment nc LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON nc.user_id = su.user_id WHERE nc.note_id = #{noteId} AND nc.del_flag = 0 ORDER BY nc.create_time DESC

SELECT nc.comment_id, nc.note_id, nc.content, nc.parent_id, nc.create_time, su.nickname AS author, su.avatar, (nc.user_id = #{userId}) AS is_owner FROM note_comment nc LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON nc.user_id = su.user_id WHERE nc.comment_id = #{commentId} AND nc.del_flag = 0
